data.name: Nereina
data.gender_notes: Nereina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Nereus', which means 'sea' or 'wavy'. In Christian tradition, Nereina is believed to be a name for those reborn in Christ, symbolizing purity and new life. The name Nereina carries the meaning “Reborn, pure one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Nereina usually hope their child will grow to embody reborn, pure one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes rebirth and purity in Christian spirituality
data.etymology: Nereina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reborn, pure one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nereina total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: נרינה
in_hebrew.meaning: נרינה משמעות שם הנערה היפה והשליויה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: נרינה הוא שם נערה שמקורו במילה היוונית 'נηρεϊς', שפירושה 'בת הים' או 'נערה של הים'. השם נגזר מהמילה 'נηρεύς', שפירושה 'שקט' או 'רגוע'. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורת הנוצרית כסמל לשלום ושלווה.

in_greek.name: Νερείνα
in_greek.meaning: Νερείνα σημαίνει η κόρη του ωκεανού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νερείνα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'Νηρεϊς', που σημαίνει 'κόρη του ωκεανού' ή 'θυγατέρα της θάλασσας'. Η λέξη 'Νηρεϊς' είναι παράγωγο της λέξης 'νηρεύς', που σημαίνει 'ήσυχος' ή 'ακίνητος'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την ηρεμία και την γαλήνη.

in_latin.name: Nereina
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Nereina originates from the Greek word 'Nereis', meaning 'daughter of the sea' or 'calm one'. The term 'Nereis' is derived from 'nereus', signifying 'calm' or 'serene'. In Christian tradition, the name Nereina represents tranquility and peacefulness, reflecting the serene nature of the sea.

in_english.name: Nereina
in_english.meaning: Nereina means calm, peaceful, and serene sea daughter
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nereina originates from the Greek roots 'Nereis', meaning 'daughter of the sea', and 'nereus', signifying 'calm' or 'serene'. In Christian tradition, Nereina symbolizes peacefulness, tranquility, and serenity, reflecting the calm nature of the sea. Historically, the name has been associated with the Nereids, the sea nymphs in Greek mythology. Today, Nereina remains a popular name in many Christian cultures, representing a connection to the soothing and peaceful aspects of the ocean.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Nereina, derived from the Greek name Nereus, symbolizes adaptability and flexibility in the face of life's ever-changing currents, as the ancient sea god was known for his ability to transform into various shapes. Spiritually, it represents resilience and openness, reflecting one's ability to flow with the ebbs and flows of life while maintaining inner peace and grace.

historical_references.reference: According to ancient Greek mythology, Nereus was a god of the sea, and his daughter Nereids were sea nymphs. Nereina is believed to be one of the Nereids. The name Nereina may have been adopted by early Christians in honor of the Virgin Mary, who was also associated with the sea as a protector and provider of sustenance.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient Greek mythology during the Hellenistic period (323-146 BC)

historical_references.reference: In medieval Europe, Nereina was identified with the Virgin Mary, particularly in the works of Dante Alighieri (1265-1321). Dante placed Nereina, along with other sea nymphs, in the Earthly Paradise, where she served as a symbol of divine love and the transformative power of grace.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nereina, derived from the ancient Roman goddess of the sea, Nereid, has seen a modern resurgence in various contexts, particularly among neo-pagan and spiritual communities. It is often used as a given name for girls and is also popular as a feminine name for goddesses, altars, and other spiritual practices. Nereina is also associated with women's empowerment and self-expression, as seen on social media platforms like Instagram, Tumblr, and Pinterest, where users share images, poems, and personal stories related to the name and its meanings. These platforms provide a community for those who identify with the name and its associated trends to connect, share, and learn from one another.
